Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.testing

package org.aristonis.diwan.database.testing
Test support: a JUnit 5 extension that gives every test a clean database, and assertions on database rows and models.

RefreshDatabase migrates once per run and then either rolls each test back or empties the tables after it. DatabaseAssertions has no JUnit dependency and works from any test framework.

JUnit and the eloquent module are compile-time dependencies of this module only: an application that does not use the extension needs no JUnit on its class path, and one that does not assert on models needs no eloquent. The extension needs JUnit 5.10 or later. Production code belongs in the other modules, not here.

Rollback mode keeps a test's data in one transaction on the test thread only; work on other threads, or a test under @Timeout(threadMode = SEPARATE_THREAD), commits for real. Truncate mode refuses parallel execution. dropAllTables on PostgreSQL leaves types, sequences and functions, so migrations drop their own or use a dedicated schema.
